posts.text: As Pres. Trump uses executive power in new and unprecedented ways, tune in to @CNN tonight @ 8pm ET/PT to find out how we got here. In my latest special, “The Imperial Presidency,” I’ll trace the decades-long history of the US presidency getting more and more powerful—well beyond what the Founders intended

This weekend, amid a fragile, three-day ceasefire with Ukraine, Russia celebrated Victory Day — the anniversary of the Soviet defeat of Nazi Germany in World War II. Why was the celebration so muted compared to years past? And what does it say about President Putin's grip on power? I explored:

Video

Executive power in the US has grown steadily for decades and ballooned massively under President Trump. My new documentary special, "The Imperial Presidency," examines how this happened, and why it poses a very real threat to American democracy. It airs tonight at 8pm ET on CNN. Here's a sneak preview:

Video

What can you learn about America's centuries of history by going on a road trip?

I spoke w/ Pulitzer Prize-winning historian @beverlygage, who did just that to better understand America’s complex past. She wrote about it in her new book, “This Land Is Your Land”:

Video

“Israel is hoping for no agreement. For Israel, no deal is better than a bad deal.”

In Part 2 of our conversation, I discussed Israel’s calculus in the Iran war — and more — w/ @citrinowicz, who served as head of the Iran branch of Israel’s military intelligence:

Video

Are Washington and Tehran any closer to ending their war? And what would a new Iran nuclear deal look like?

I asked @citrinowicz, who served as head of the Iran branch of Israel’s military intelligence, in Part 1 of our conversation:

Video

Does Washington want to change certain policies of Iran, or does it want to change Iran?

That tension has run through U.S. policy for almost half a century. And President Trump is right back to the same dilemma.

My take:

Tonight: the ever-expanding power of the American presidency. Tune in to @CNN @ 8pm ET/PT for my latest documentary, “The Imperial Presidency.” In it, I’ll trace the expansion of executive power from Truman to Trump

On GPS, at 10am & 1pm ET today on @CNN: I’ll discuss US–Iran endgames with @citrinowicz, who formerly headed Iran analysis for Israel’s military intelligence. I’ll also ask Pulitzer-winning historian @beverlygage about road-tripping through US history, and I’ll examine why Russia’s annual Victory Day parade was scaled back compared to previous years—and what that says about Pres. Vladimir Putin’s grip on power

How did the US presidency get so powerful? In a country founded on democratic checks and balances, executive authority has been expanding since long before Pres.
